formulas.ascii: Polsby-Popper C=4*pi*A/P^2; Schwartzberg S=sqrt(C); convexity V=min(A/H,1) for hull area H; elongation E=1-sqrt(lambda2/lambda1) with lambda2=max(mean-radius,0), lambda1=mean+radius from central moments. Sliver is P>0 and (A<=0 or C<threshold). C and S are NaN unless A>0 and P>0, V is NaN without positive hull area, E is NaN without a positive major eigenvalue. Shells contribute positive area and holes negative, regardless of winding.
